pitch: Teddy the corgi wins back four sandcastles, his toys and his crown from his big sister Gwin, one tower and one trick at a time.

keys.T: Spin trick: bowls over ants and beetles

items.title: Map of the sandbox
items.heading: THE SANDBOX: EVERY SECRET MARKED
items.intro: Teddy's own map of the backyard sandbox, with the castles, the shortcuts and every secret. Red stars are secrets: don't peek until you're stuck!

panels.caption: The sandbox. Each castle you win sets you down in the next corner.

marks.label: Teddy's toy chest: you start here. The shovel and a tennis ball are right beside it.
Anthill Keep (castle 1), inside the ring of dunes
Low Tide Lagoon (castle 3), past the kiddie pool
Not an ant's hole: it dials THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS
The hose's lazy loop: ride it round and round
An extra life hidden in the little dune ring
A hole in the courtyard leads very deep down, and back up again
A cracked wall: walk into it
Another cracked wall, with an acorn behind it

legend: Green arrows: where you start. Gold dots: castles and goals. Red stars: secrets.

items.title: Sandcastle Knight Hint Book
items.note: Answers hidden: use the red film
items.intro: Find your question, then lay the red film over the answer. Good dogs only read one answer at a time.

hints.a: Right beside Teddy's toy chest in the southwest corner, where you start. Press P to pick it up.

hints.q: How do I get into Anthill Keep?
hints.a: Dig through the ring of dunes with the shovel. Two bites and a dune is gone, and you keep the sand.

hints.q: What is the tennis ball for?
hints.a: Gwin moves for it. Walk toward her and press F, and she trots off happy to bury it.

hints.q: The gate of Anthill Keep won't open.
hints.a: Build all four towers (one sand each), then walk into each tower again to plant its flag. Four flags lift the gate.
Walk into each anthill with sand in your can: one scoop plugs it for good.

hints.q: How do I cross the Hosewater Moat?
hints.a: Two scoops of sand fill the south ford. The west bridge is free but crumbles after one crossing.
Only water flips a crab. Or, with the bucket, walk into a dashed outline to pack a wall the crab can't pass.
It wants three golden shells. They are out on the sandbars: grab them while the tide is out.

hints.q: There aren't enough acorns in the Burrows.
hints.a: One more acorn is hidden behind a cracked wall. Walk into the cracks.

hints.q: How do I get the crown back?
hints.a: Fill your bucket at the water bowls, take a step toward a paw, and splash it twice. She tucks it in. Then the next paw.

hints.q: The slobbery balls keep rolling at me.
hints.a: Keep moving and fling sand at them; save your water for her paws.

items.title: A note from Gwin
items.body:
i am sorry about the castles. And the hose. And the kiddie pool. And the hole. The beetles were already there i think.

i did not mean to sit on your crown. it was warm and the patio was sunny and i was so tired from the zoomies.

You can have the tennis ball back. It is under the tomato plants. It is a little wet.

You are the best brother and the best knight.

items.title: The Backyard Bugle
items.headline: ZOOMIES FLATTEN SANDBOX
items.deck: Four castles down, hose in the moat, crown missing; local corgi vows to rebuild

photo.caption: The scene this morning: the toy chest, a shovel and not one castle standing.

columns:
THE SANDBOX - Residents woke this morning to find every sandcastle in the backyard sandbox flattened. Witnesses describe a brown blur moving "very, very fast" shortly after breakfast.

The hose was left running into the moat. The kiddie pool is now a lagoon.

The suspect, Gwin, a brown pit-lab mix, was later found asleep on the patio. She is believed to be lying on the Crown of the Sandbox.

"She's not a bad dog," said one neighbor. "She's a good girl who knocks things over."

Teddy, a Pembroke Welsh Corgi and the sandbox's only knight, has picked up his shovel. Asked about his plans, he sat, offered a paw, and rolled over.

Ants, beetles and crabs are said to be moving into the ruins.
briefs: Last seen near the tomato plants. Reward: one belly rub.
Neighbors report squealing from the upstairs window. Probably the BBS.
Sunny. Low tide in the lagoon by noon.

items.title: Knight of the Sandbox card
items.name: TEDDY
fields: Sit, spin, roll, jump, play dead
items.back: The bearer of this card is a knight of the sandbox, sworn to rebuild every castle, plug every anthill and share every tennis ball (eventually).

news.head: Teddy's next adventure
news.html: Registered Sandcastle Knight players were promised the next Teddy adventure on disk, and here it comes: Teddy's Little Big Adventure is on our workbench now. Your copy is on the house; watch the BBS for it.
